key_insight: HistoLoop iteratively refines spatial context to predict gene expression from H&E histology images, achieving the highest average correlation among compared methods.
clinical_relevance: Predicted spatial gene expression could support research into tumor biology, but the abstract does not establish clinical utility or drug discovery outcomes.
method: Construct context tokens from current tissue-spot states at progressively finer resolutions.
Use a shared spatial Transformer and cross-attention to retrieve spot-specific context.
Update persistent spot states through memory-mediated refinement before rebuilding context.
evidence_signal: Under HEST-Bench HVG50 evaluation, HistoLoop achieved the highest macro-averaged gene-wise Pearson correlation among compared methods across six cancer-specific tasks spanning five organs in HEST-1K.
watch_item: The abstract reports benchmark performance without numerical effect sizes; generalization beyond the evaluated tasks remains unestablished.
paper_title: HistoLoop: Iterative Contextual Inference with a Looped Transformer for Histology-Based Spatial Gene Expression Prediction
